label: Vector
description: A path of points and curves, drawn with the pen or the pencil.

pen.label: Pen
pen.description: Draw paths of points and curves; drag while placing a point to curve it.

move.label: Move points
move.description: Pick and drag points, segments and handles.

pen.label: Pen
pen.description: Add points, extend ends, join points.

bend.label: Bend
bend.description: Drag a segment to curve it; click a point to smooth it.

bucket.label: Paint bucket
bucket.description: Click an enclosed area to fill it, or a filled one to unfill it.

cut.label: Cut
cut.description: Click a segment to cut it.
